scenes.heading: Maven Modules & Package Types (Part 1 of 2)
scenes.narration: Env Setup. Maven Modules & Package Types (Part 1 of 2). In this video we review 5 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: Which Maven module contains the Java OSGi bundle (services, models, servlets)?
scenes.heading: core
scenes.body: The `core` module is the Java Maven module that compiles into an OSGi bundle (`.jar`). It contains Java code: OSGi services, Sling Models, servlets, workflow steps, and scheduled jobs.

scenes.question: What is the package type of the ui.apps module?
scenes.heading: application
scenes.body: The `ui.apps` module has the package type `application`. This designates it as a code package that targets immutable repository paths (`/apps`). AEMaaCS uses the package type to enforce deployment rules.
scenes.narration: What is the package type of the ui.apps module? application. The `ui.apps` module has the package type `application`. This designates it as a code package that targets immutable repository paths (`/apps`). AEMaaCS uses the package type to enforce deployment rules.

scenes.question: What is the package type of the ui.content module?
scenes.heading: content
scenes.body: The `ui.content` module has the package type `content`. This designates it as a content package that targets mutable repository paths (`/content`, `/conf`). It can be modified at runtime by authors.
scenes.narration: What is the package type of the ui.content module? content. The `ui.content` module has the package type `content`. This designates it as a content package that targets mutable repository paths (`/content`, `/conf`). It can be modified at runtime by authors.

scenes.question: What is the package type of the 'all' module?
scenes.heading: container
scenes.body: The `all` module has the package type `container`. As a container package, it embeds all other modules (core bundle, ui.apps, ui.content, ui.config) and is the single artifact deployed by Cloud Manager.

scenes.question: What is the role of the 'all' module in an AEM Maven project?
scenes.heading: It is the container package and the single deployment artifact used by Cloud Manager
scenes.body: The `all` module is the container package that embeds every other module (core OSGi bundle, ui.apps, ui.content, ui.config). Cloud Manager deploys only the `all` package — all other packages must have `cloudManagerTarget` set to `none`.
